member.name: T:Crowbar.Command
member.summary:
Allows for creating custom DeterministicCommands.
Works by hijacking SpecialActionCommand and using unique action IDs.

member.name: P:Crowbar.Command.Identifier
member.summary: The unique identifier for this command.

param.name: callback
param.para: The function to call when the command is sent.

It is called for every client, including the caller.
For the caller specifically, it is called multiple times (on every predicted frame
plus the final verified one); if you don't want this, add a check for Frame.IsVerified.

member.name: T:Crowbar.Packet
member.summary:
Allows for sending an arbitrary string dictionary to all other players; this should not be done often.
Works by making use of Realtime.Player.CustomProperties.
Do not use the key "__identifier" since that is reserved for internal use.
